entries.subject: Farkas-Takacs et al. K2 light curve and size constraints
entries.finding: K2 variability supplies a minimum-elongation model; thermal diameter 42 (+20/−12) km is a tentative one-band fit with broad beaming degeneracy. Table 4 supports the adopted doubled 9.948-hour rotation, while the paper text mistakenly pairs half frequency with 4.9742 hours. Minimum elongation assumes uniform reflectivity and an equator-on view. Equal short axes, volume normalization, pole, spin sense and meridian remain display assumptions; no resolved surface or unique three-dimensional shape is established.
